hunter.title: Hunter: a herd for each drone, combat skills, melt for money, carapace for the reserve
hunter.note: 2026-11-17 08:16 UTC: holds stored first; the soma, melt and curd sales open only with stock and a bid; seven hollow-pilgrim hunts (crystal melt, standing while Sirius bids 1,000 for any depth); four one-ship tests (halo-drifters at Gemma, the cauldronback at Node Beta, slag-tortoises at Garnet, two cinder-sylphs); 21 grazer hunts storing carapace; seven veil-ray hunts and the drift-ray hunt; then steel smelted from stored iron (no fuel, steel plate short); iron gathering last, copper after it. Every hunt beyond the border leaves only for a pirate or a hostile pilot (alone pirates, except Felis).

guard.title: Guard: one drone at each field beyond the border where our miners work
guard.note: 2026-11-17 08:16 UTC: one drone at each field beyond the border where ships of ours gather (Schedar Belt up to 45, Ironhollow's two belts up to 20 and 25, Garnet Belt up to 10: admirals.log ENT-017); each opens only while a ship of ours flies the guarded route and never fires. Garnet is the outpost site Mining and Intel name: its guard is the first reading of the place Military will guard.
